description: Hook entries decide the chapter kind (deliver, escort, warn, retrieve) and carry the patron-side text. Placeholders resolve against the roll context.

entries.title: A Parcel for {contact.first}
entries.entrance: hurries out of the dark, clutching {stake.full} close
entries.pitch: Please, wait. I'm carrying {stake.short} to its owner tonight, and I think I'm being followed.
entries.answer: I took it on trust, and I can't see who is behind me. It has to arrive before dawn.
entries.accept: Then come with me to {dest.name}. {contact.first} is expecting {stake.short}, and I'd feel safer with you beside me.

entries.title: A Promise to Keep
entries.pitch: I swore to an old friend that {stake.short} would reach {contact.first}. Tonight I may not keep my word.
entries.answer: My friend is gone now. This is all I have left of the promise, and I won't see it lost.
entries.accept: Thank you. {contact.first} will be at {dest.name}. Get me there, and my promise is kept.

entries.title: Quiet Hands, Quiet Words
entries.entrance: slips from a doorway and holds out {stake.full}
entries.pitch: Take {stake.short} the last stretch to its owner, and tell no one. I can't be seen with it.
entries.answer: I'm known here, and watched. If I walk with you, they will know. Please, just take it from here.
entries.accept: Then listen: it goes to {contact.first} at {dest.name}. I'll walk a few steps behind, as if I don't know you.

entries.title: A Dangerous Journey
entries.entrance: hurries toward your lantern, pale and out of breath
entries.pitch: Please escort me to {contact.first} before dawn. I'm carrying {stake.short}, and someone follows.
entries.answer: I'm carrying {stake.short} for {contact.first}, and whoever is behind me knows it.
entries.accept: {contact.first} will be at {dest.name}. Stay close, and I'll see that you're thanked.

entries.title: What {patron.first} Saw
entries.entrance: pushes through the dark toward you, eyes wide and glancing back
entries.pitch: I saw what happened to {stake.short}. Escort me safely to {contact.first}, and I'll tell you.
entries.answer: I can't say it aloud, not here. But it concerns {stake.short}, and it can't wait.
entries.accept: {contact.first} is waiting at {dest.name}. Once I'm there, I can finally tell it all.

entries.title: A Vow Before Dawn
entries.entrance: limps up to you on a staff, holding {stake.full}
entries.pitch: I vowed to bring {stake.short} to {contact.first} by dawn, and my legs won't carry me there alone.
entries.answer: It is an old vow, and I'm too proud to break it. Too tired to keep it, though, without help.
entries.accept: To {dest.name}, then. {contact.first} will be waiting. Thank you; the journey has been long and lonely.

entries.title: Word Before Dawn
entries.entrance: runs up to you, one hand raised and breathing hard
entries.pitch: Warn {contact.first}: {stake.short} is proof of danger, and I cannot reach them in time.
entries.answer: The warning is about {stake.short}. If {contact.first} doesn't hear it in time, there won't be a second chance.
entries.accept: Go to {dest.name}. Tell {contact.first} that {patron.first} sent you, and that the warning was true.

entries.title: A Light Going Out
entries.entrance: hurries toward you, shielding a small flame with {pos} hand
entries.pitch: Warn {contact.first}: the wards are failing, and {stake.short} proves it.
entries.answer: Nobody listens to me. But {stake.short} proves it, and {contact.first} will know what it means.
entries.accept: {dest.name|cap} is the place. Walk with me, and if anyone stops us, let them see you're ready.

entries.title: The Missed Signal
entries.entrance: waves to catch your attention, anxious and apologetic
entries.pitch: Warn {contact.first} tonight: {stake.short} proves someone cut off the signal.
entries.answer: I don't know who, but I know it was deliberate. And {stake.short} is the only proof I have.
entries.accept: Then we go to {dest.name}. {contact.first} will know how to read {stake.short}, if we arrive in time.

entries.title: A Remedy Promised
entries.entrance: hurries toward you, twisting a worn cloth in {pos} hands
entries.pitch: A sick child needs {stake.full}. {contact.first} holds it; help me ask for it back.
entries.answer: I was told {contact.first} would give it freely, if I can only reach {contact.obj} in one piece.
entries.accept: {dest.name|cap}. Hurry, if you can. Every hour counts, and I will not forget your kindness.

entries.title: What Was Taken
entries.entrance: approaches in a rush, anger and hope mingled on {pos} face
entries.pitch: Thieves took {stake.full}. {contact.first} has it; help me ask for it back with witnesses.
entries.answer: I could go alone, but they would call me a liar. With you beside me, they can't.
entries.accept: Come to {dest.name}. {contact.first} said to ask there, and to bring friends.

entries.title: A Favor Called In
entries.entrance: steps into your path, one hand outstretched in greeting
entries.pitch: An old friend, {contact.first}, holds {stake.full} for me. Collecting it alone has become dangerous.
entries.answer: Someone else wants it as badly as I do, and they have been watching my door.
entries.accept: {contact.first} waits at {dest.name}. Walk me there, and I'll make sure you're repaid.
